symptom: depcruise reported an architecture violation: AuthModule and UserModule were importing NotificationService from its internal path instead of the public barrel
rootcause: The import was written as a direct internal path (e.g., .../notification/application/notification.service) rather than going through the module's public index.ts barrel. This broke the hexagonal boundary rule that cross-module imports must use the public API
fix: Changed all cross-module imports of NotificationService to use the notification module's public index.ts barrel
